articles.title: Emmanuel Rodriguez homers in first big league at-bat during Twins win: ‘What a day today’
articles.description: Rodriguez, a 23-year-old outfielder, batted .262 with 11 homers and a .414 on-base percentage in 49 games at Class AAA.

articles.title: Minnesota Twins’ Matt Wallner expects to be off roster after season
articles.description: The Forest Lake native has put up big numbers in the minors, but sees no path back with the Twins. He remains confident he can succeed in the majors — somewhere else.

articles.title: The Twins’ infield defense has been a weak spot for years. Brooks Lee changed that with one move.
articles.description: The former first-round pick ranks among MLB’s top defenders at his new position, a development that has exceeded even the Twins’ expectations.

articles.title: Minnesota Twins top prospects: 13 minor league players who stood out
articles.description: From Marek Houston’s 50 stolen bases to Caden Kendle’s Class AA breakout, these Twins prospects delivered some of the farm system’s best performances in 2026.

articles.title: Byron Buxton injury update: MN Twins star to have season-ending surgery
articles.description: Buxton had hoped to return for the Twins’ playoff push, but will undergo season-ending surgery on his right hip. He is expected to be ready for the start of the 2027 season.

articles.title: Reusse: Twins fans have waited years for a leadoff hitter like Luke Keaschall. He’s worth embracing.
articles.description: Keaschall has the speed, power and patience the Twins have long coveted atop their lineup. And the 24-year-old former wrestler brings some old-school toughness, too.

articles.title: Twins still have a heartbeat, edge Tigers behind Kody Clemens’ home run
articles.description: Dean Kremer and four relievers combined to stymie Detroit as Twins remained four games behind in AL wild card race.

articles.title: Twins’ playoff hopes all but disappear after dismal road trip ends with loss to Tigers
articles.description: Zebby Matthews delivered one of his worst starts of the season against Detroit on Wednesday, perhaps the final blow to the Twins’ wild-card chances.

articles.title: The Twins’ playoff hopes are slipping away. Can they fix their road woes before it’s too late?
articles.description: The Twins are three games out of the final AL wild-card spot with 22 to play. A six-game road trip through Chicago and Detroit could reshape their postseason chances.

articles.title: Twins’ playoff hopes take another hit in nationally televised blowout loss to White Sox
articles.description: The Twins enter tonight 3½ games out of the final AL wild-card spot with 20 to play. Bailey Ober starts in the prime-time rubber match on Peacock and NBC Sports Network.

articles.title: Joe Ryan delivers encouraging return, but Twins can’t finish comeback against Tigers
articles.description: Joe Ryan returns to the mound after a month on the injured list, with the Twins 4½ games out of the final AL wild-card spot. Follow the score, highlights and analysis from Detroit.

articles.title: Nine years after the Twins’ historic turnaround, the White Sox are closing in on an unprecedented feat
articles.description: The 2017 Twins were the first MLB team to make the playoffs after a 100-loss season. Now, the White Sox are on the verge of going one step further by winning the AL Central.
